Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 25
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely concluded that multiple gyms (including Crunch Fitness and Cage Fitness in Mount Pleasant, SC) were within 5 miles of the Mothman Museum and applicable to West Virginia. It failed to filter by state and driving distance, misclassifying out-of-state results as in-scope, leading to an incorrect internal determination that the request was satisfied.
